steps.message:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-19, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 609.2 | 25.53 | 25.53

4 | 4556.7 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as KH-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-19, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-19**

Station T-19 comprises a four-layer geoelectric section:
- **Layer 1 (0–25.53 m):** Top layer with a resistivity of 609.2 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$.
- **Layer 2 (25.53–47.55 m):** High-resistivity resistive unit at 7309.9 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$ (thickness: 22.02 m).
- **Layer 3 (47.55–47.97 m):** Thin conductive horizon at 4367.7 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$ (thickness: 0.42 m).
- **Layer 4 (>47.97 m):** Basal basement layer at 4556.7 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$.

Evaluating successive layer triads:
- Layers 1–3 ($r_1 < r_2 > r_3$) yield a **K-type** segment.
- Layers 2–4 ($r_2 > r_3 < r_4$) yield an **H-type** segment.

The combined geoelectric response corresponds to a **KH-type** curve, consistent with the survey interpretation on file.
